intro: Plantation Dew is an HDB BTO project in Tengah, listed in the November 2026 BTO exercise with 710 flats, as recorded from HDB’s BTO portal in our project file. That official confirmation covers the launch and the unit count only. TOP and key-collection dates are unconfirmed. Tenure is left blank. Use your HDB documents for typologies, and do not treat a portal launch as a handover date. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Plantation Dew renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Plantation Dew interior
sections.text:
A newly launched Tengah BTO is still years from renovation, which is useful in a town that is itself still being built out. When HDB issues your approved plan, the interior brief that usually pays off is built-in: a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry or fridge run, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, with a built-in desk if a common bedroom will be a study. Maison specifies this as custom carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture. No official floor plan is on file, and we will not invent typologies or a typical Plantation Dew layout.

Brickland Weave and Plantation Edge I & II are unconfirmed near-completion pages in the same town and are not a guide to when Dew will get keys. Plantation Creek, Garden Waterfront I & II and Plantation Verge were packed earlier. We will not invent walking times to any present or future MRT station, and we will not assign a view from the project name.

Keep the official plan when it is issued, and write to us when you want the carpentry drawings frozen well before any permit is due. After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your unit type and plan when you have them. We are not affiliated with HDB.
